# danestves LLC

> danestves LLC is the software studio of Daniel Esteves (danestves), a developer from Venezuela writing software since 2016. It builds and publishes the apps Outlayr and Vela, and builds iOS, Android and web apps for clients.

## Apps

- [Outlayr](https://danestves.com/projects/outlayr/): an expense tracker and budget app where you log a purchase in one sentence. Site: https://tryoutlayr.com. Not affiliated with Outlayr, Inc.
- [Vela](https://danestves.com/projects/vela/): a private period tracker that encrypts before anything syncs. Site: https://hellovela.app

## Studio

- [Studio](https://danestves.com/studio/): how danestves LLC builds apps for clients, with Expo, React Native, SwiftUI, React, Laravel and Astro
- [Contact](https://danestves.com/contact/): start a project, or write to hi@danestves.com

## Open source

- [remix-auth-auth0](https://danestves.com/projects/remix-auth-auth0/): an Auth0 strategy for Remix Auth
- [laravel-polar](https://danestves.com/projects/laravel-polar/): Polar.sh subscriptions and payments for Laravel
